description: Manual gate — all eight outputs send +5V while the TRIG button is held, 0V otherwise

params.text: Holds every output high for as long as it is pressed

outputs.text: +5V while the TRIG button is held down, 0V the rest of the time

menu: Trigger on load — every output emits a 10ms pulse at the high voltage 100ms after the patch starts running, which is the equivalent of a loadbang
Output — the voltage a button puts out when it is on, +5V or +10V
